discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: After 2024 (machine learning) and 2025 (macroscopic quantum tunnelling in circuits), condensed matter is due for a turn. Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field: Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state, and Molenkamp's group confirmed it experimentally in HgTe quantum wells. All three have won major precursor prizes (Breakthrough, Dirac, Buckley). Shoucheng Zhang's death leaves a clean trio.
